name: Adeolu Ogunnoiki
headline: AI and Machine Learning Engineer
bio:
**I build AI and machine learning systems from the algorithm up, and validate them against established libraries.**

Transformers and autodiff, vector search, alignment and post-training, retrieval, agents, evaluation,
and the infrastructure around them, written in Python, Go, Rust, and TypeScript, choosing the language
that fits each problem. Projects ship with green CI, versioned releases, and measured benchmarks, and
are checked against widely used reference libraries where it matters.

flagships.name: agent-platform
flagships.description: An integrated AI platform: authenticated API, LLM gateway, tool-using agents, multi-agent jobs with durable crash recovery, tenant-isolated retrieval, tracing, and evaluation, composed from from-scratch libraries.
flagships.summary: An integrated AI platform composed from eight of these libraries
flagships.result: Authenticated multi-tenant API, gateway, agents, retrieval, tracing, evaluation; a worker **killed mid-job resumes without re-running steps** (SIGKILL test in CI)

flagships.name: transformer-from-scratch
flagships.description: A reverse-mode automatic differentiation engine and a decoder-only transformer language model, built from scratch; gradients verified against finite differences and attention demonstrated on a copy task.
flagships.summary: A decoder-only transformer and a reverse-mode autodiff engine
flagships.result: Matches **PyTorch to < 1e-9**; **3.64 bits/char** on real text vs 4.30; a pre-registered 8-seed study whose induction hypothesis was **not supported**

flagships.name: evaluation-harness
flagships.description: A from-scratch evaluation and benchmarking framework for language models and agents: pluggable tasks and graders, bootstrap confidence intervals, significance testing, and contamination checks.
flagships.summary: A model and agent evaluation framework
flagships.result: Statistics cross-checked against **scipy to machine precision**: bootstrap CIs, McNemar, Cohen's d

flagships.name: ann-vector-search-library
flagships.description: An approximate nearest neighbor vector search library built from scratch in Python, implementing HNSW graphs; high recall at a fraction of a brute-force scan's distance computations, with measured recall and cost.
flagships.result: **Matches hnswlib's recall** at matched parameters; latency curves vs hnswlib and FAISS reported as measured

flagships.name: rlhf-reward-model
flagships.description: Classical RLHF from scratch: a Bradley-Terry reward model and a clipped PPO policy optimizer, with an explicit reward over-optimization study.
flagships.summary: Reward modeling with PPO and DPO
flagships.result: PPO vs DPO on the same preference task, and a **reward over-optimization (Goodhart) study**

flagships.name: constrained-generation-library
flagships.description: A structured-generation library built from scratch in Python: compiles a JSON Schema into a finite automaton and masks a model's tokens so output is schema-valid by construction (100% valid JSON across any model versus 0% unconstrained).
flagships.result: **240 of 240** outputs validate against the `jsonschema` reference; agree on 2,008 cases

flagships.name: llm-gateway
flagships.description: A safety proxy for language-model APIs built from scratch: prompt-injection defense, PII redaction, output-policy enforcement, and a semantic cache, with an adversarial suite measuring injection precision and recall and PII-redaction recall.
flagships.summary: An LLM gateway: safety, caching, reliability
flagships.result: Retry and failover, **per-tenant isolation**, injection and PII detection, concurrency-tested

flagships.name: hybrid-rag
flagships.description: Production hybrid retrieval from scratch: BM25 and a trained TF-IDF dense retriever, reciprocal-rank fusion, a reranker, and a retrieval evaluation suite.
flagships.summary: Hybrid retrieval with a neural dense retriever
flagships.result: Full evaluation suite; the dense retriever ties recall but ranks below strong lexical baselines at this scale

flagships.name: react-agent
flagships.description: A ReAct reasoning-and-acting agent built from scratch: tool use, a transparent control loop, and full step tracing.
flagships.result: **Adversarial** tool-use robustness, recovery, and a benchmark against a single-shot baseline

flagships.name: training-provenance
flagships.description: Content-addressed provenance tracking for machine learning pipelines: a deduplicating artifact store, a content-addressed lineage DAG, and bit-for-bit reproducibility and integrity verification.
flagships.result: End-to-end reproduce, crash recovery, and an exhaustive **tamper-detection matrix**

flagships.name: multi-agent-orchestrator
flagships.description: A multi-agent orchestrator from scratch: a planner decomposes a task, workers execute subtasks, and a critic verifies, over a shared blackboard.
flagships.summary: Planner, worker, and critic over a shared blackboard
flagships.result: **Durable execution** with resume, and a single-agent vs orchestrator comparison

flagships.name: vectordb-go
flagships.description: A concurrent, persistent HNSW vector database server in Go: write-ahead log with checksums, snapshot and replay crash recovery, HTTP API, and benchmarks against hnswlib and FAISS.
flagships.summary: A persistent HNSW vector database server in Go (`brew install adeoluo/tap/vectordb`)
flagships.result: Checksummed write-ahead log, snapshot and replay crash recovery, benchmarked against hnswlib and FAISS

repos.name: cnn-from-scratch
repos.description: A convolutional neural network and its explicit backpropagation (conv2d, pooling, dense), built from scratch in Python; gradients verified against finite differences and translation invariance demonstrated against a linear baseline.

repos.name: neural-word-embeddings
repos.description: Skip-gram word embeddings with negative sampling from scratch: hand-derived gradients, a unigram negative-sampling table, and category-retrieval evaluation.

repos.name: bpe-tokenizer-library
repos.description: A byte-level BPE tokenizer implementing the GPT-2 algorithm, with a reference Python implementation and an optional Rust core (PyO3) that produces identical token ids; lossless for any input.

repos.name: corpus-dedup-library
repos.description: A corpus near-deduplication and quality-filtering library built from scratch in Python using MinHash and LSH; perfect precision and recall on a labeled corpus while comparing a tiny fraction of all document pairs.

repos.name: crf-sequence-labeler
repos.description: A linear-chain conditional random field for sequence labeling from scratch: Viterbi decoding, forward-backward training with log-likelihood gradients, and span-level evaluation.

repos.name: dependency-parser
repos.description: An arc-standard transition-based dependency parser from scratch: a static oracle, an averaged structured perceptron policy, greedy decoding, and attachment-score evaluation.

repos.name: statistical-translation
repos.description: Statistical machine translation alignment from scratch: IBM Model 1 and Model 2 word alignment trained by expectation-maximization, with alignment-error-rate evaluation.

repos.name: topic-model-lda
repos.description: Latent Dirichlet allocation from scratch: collapsed Gibbs sampling for topic discovery with UMass topic-coherence evaluation.
